indicator_name: Kazakhstan import tariff averages (MFN and applied, simple and weighted), percent
description: Средние ставки импортных пошлин Казахстана (MFN и применяемые, простые и взвешенные), %
methodology: WITS TradeStats-Tariff, all products. MFN = most-favoured-nation rate; AHS = effectively applied (preferential where one exists: zero inside the EAEU). Since 2010 Kazakhstan applies the EAEU common external tariff.
